name: @sasjs/release
description: Host-neutral releases from conventional commits: version, notes, tag, release. Zero dependencies.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; if (v === '0.0.0') { console.error('refusing to publish 0.0.0: the version is stamped from the tag (npm version <tag> --no-git-tag-version)'); process.exit(1) }"
